    ### 2.1. Results from DIABLO (block.plsda)
    final.plsda.diablo <- readRDS("/Users/wmujchariyak/Desktop/final.plsda.diablo.rds")
    loadings_data <- final.plsda.diablo$loadings 

    loadings_data_trans <- loadings_data$Transcript   %>%  as.data.frame(.) %>% 
                     rownames_to_column(., var = "core_entity_id") %>% 
                     rename(loadings = comp1)
    loadings_data_prot <- loadings_data$Protein   %>%  as.data.frame(.) %>% 
                     rownames_to_column(., var = "core_entity_id") %>% 
                     rename(loadings = comp1)

                     rename(loadings = comp1)

    all_DE.df.strep <- all_DE.df %>%
      filter(species == "Streptococcus pyogenes") %>%
